answer: Brakedown encodes the witness in linear time, so proving is fast even for large circuits. A farm needs 430 separate Brakedown proofs, since each encoding is bound to its own witness. The encoding is verified on-chain, and the proof size stays manageable. The oasis check runs in the open: 430 fakes pay the full price 430 times, one honest agent pays once, and the nebula trail in the ledger makes the terrace cost visible to everyone.
